pokedexEntries.di: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

pokedexEntries.prl: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

pokedexEntries.pt: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

pokedexEntries.hgss: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

pokedexEntries.la: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
